summary: Shared values as assets, so two systems can read the same number without referencing each other.
overview: A value held in an asset instead of a singleton or a cross-scene reference. The health bar reads the same FloatVariable the player writes, and neither needs to find the other. The generic base cannot be created directly — Unity disallows [CreateAssetMenu] on a generic type — so the concrete Float, Int and Bool subclasses exist to be creatable.
useCases: Player health, score or currency shared between gameplay and UI.
A difficulty or debug flag read in many places.
Decoupling two systems that only need to agree on one number.

gotchas.title: Asset values persist in the Editor between Play sessions
gotchas.body: Changes made at runtime are written into the asset and survive stopping. That is useful for tuning and a real trap for player state — reset on start if it should not carry over.

gotchas.title: Shared means shared
gotchas.body: Two scenes using the same asset share one value. That is the point, and also why per-instance state does not belong here.
